<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name: WPAX Commerce Starter
 * Description: Deterministic online store catalog (wpax_product CPT), weight-based shipping REST endpoint, and Abilities API registration.
 * Version: 1.0.0
 */

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	exit;
}

add_action(
	'init',
	static function (): void {
		register_post_type(
			'wpax_product',
			array(
				'labels'       => array(
					'name'          => 'Products',
					'singular_name' => 'Product',
				),
				'public'       => true,
				'has_archive'  => true,
				'show_in_rest' => true,
				'rest_base'    => 'wpax_product',
				'supports'     => array( 'title', 'editor', 'excerpt', 'custom-fields' ),
				'rewrite'      => array( 'slug' => 'products' ),
			)
		);

		$meta_fields = array(
			'wpax_sku'       => 'string',
			'wpax_price'     => 'number',
			'wpax_stock_qty' => 'integer',
			'wpax_weight_kg' => 'number',
		);

		foreach ( $meta_fields as $meta_key => $meta_type ) {
			register_post_meta(
				'wpax_product',
				$meta_key,
				array(
					'type'         => $meta_type,
					'single'       => true,
					'show_in_rest' => true,
				)
			);
		}
	}
);

function wpax_calculate_shipping_quote( float $weight_kg ): array {
	$weight = max( 0.0, $weight_kg );
	if ( $weight <= 0.5 ) {
		$tier = 'light-parcel';
		$rate = 5.95;
	} elseif ( $weight <= 2.0 ) {
		$tier = 'standard-parcel';
		$rate = 9.95;
	} elseif ( $weight <= 5.0 ) {
		$tier = 'heavy-parcel';
		$rate = 16.50;
	} else {
		$tier = 'freight-tiered';
		$rate = round( 16.50 + ( $weight - 5.0 ) * 2.25, 2 );
	}
	return array(
		'weight_kg' => round( $weight, 3 ),
		'tier'      => $tier,
		'currency'  => 'USD',
		'rate'      => $rate,
	);
}

function wpax_list_store_products(): array {
	$posts = get_posts(
		array(
			'post_type'      => 'wpax_product',
			'post_status'    => 'publish',
			'posts_per_page' => 50,
			'orderby'        => 'title',
			'order'          => 'ASC',
		)
	);
	$items = array();
	foreach ( $posts as $post ) {
		$items[] = array(
			'id'        => (int) $post->ID,
			'slug'      => $post->post_name,
			'name'      => $post->post_title,
			'sku'       => (string) get_post_meta( $post->ID, 'wpax_sku', true ),
			'price'     => (float) get_post_meta( $post->ID, 'wpax_price', true ),
			'stock_qty' => (int) get_post_meta( $post->ID, 'wpax_stock_qty', true ),
			'weight_kg' => (float) get_post_meta( $post->ID, 'wpax_weight_kg', true ),
		);
	}
	return $items;
}

add_action(
	'rest_api_init',
	static function (): void {
		register_rest_route(
			'wpax/v1',
			'/shipping-quote',
			array(
				'methods'             => array( WP_REST_Server::READABLE, WP_REST_Server::CREATABLE ),
				'callback'            => static function ( WP_REST_Request $request ): WP_REST_Response {
					$raw_weight = $request->get_param( 'weight_kg' );
					$weight     = null !== $raw_weight ? (float) $raw_weight : 1.0;
					return new WP_REST_Response( wpax_calculate_shipping_quote( $weight ), 200 );
				},
				'permission_callback' => '__return_true',
				'args'                => array(
					'weight_kg' => array(
						'required'          => false,
						'default'           => 1.0,
						'validate_callback' => static function ( $value ): bool {
							return is_numeric( $value ) && (float) $value >= 0;
						},
					),
				),
			)
		);
	}
);

add_action(
	'wp_abilities_api_categories_init',
	static function (): void {
		if ( function_exists( 'wp_register_ability_category' ) ) {
			wp_register_ability_category(
				'wpax',
				array(
					'label'       => 'WPAX Site Capabilities',
					'description' => 'Structured WordPress site abilities registered by WPAX starter blueprints.',
				)
			);
		}
	}
);

add_action(
	'wp_abilities_api_init',
	static function (): void {
		if ( function_exists( 'wp_register_ability' ) && function_exists( 'wp_register_ability_category' ) ) {
			wp_register_ability(
				'wpax/list-products',
				array(
					'label'               => 'List Store Products',
					'description'         => 'Returns published store products with SKU, price, stock quantity, and shipping weight.',
					'category'            => 'wpax',
					'input_schema'        => array(
						'type'                 => 'object',
						'properties'           => array(),
						'additionalProperties' => false,
					),
					'output_schema'       => array(
						'type'  => 'array',
						'items' => array(
							'type'       => 'object',
							'properties' => array(
								'id'        => array( 'type' => 'integer' ),
								'slug'      => array( 'type' => 'string' ),
								'name'      => array( 'type' => 'string' ),
								'sku'       => array( 'type' => 'string' ),
								'price'     => array( 'type' => 'number' ),
								'stock_qty' => array( 'type' => 'integer' ),
								'weight_kg' => array( 'type' => 'number' ),
							),
						),
					),
					'execute_callback'    => static function (): array {
						return wpax_list_store_products();
					},
					'permission_callback' => '__return_true',
					'meta'                => array(
						'annotations'  => array(
							'readonly' => true,
						),
						'show_in_rest' => true,
					),
				)
			);
		}
	}
);
